componentInstanceProperties.value:
Stage 1: Create/Plan


Key Activities

  • Identify Key Players
  • Stimulate interest w/pain messaging or Success stories
  • Identify potential sponsor (influencer) or power sponsor (Key decision maker)
  • Identify potential pain or critical issue

Exit Criteria

✓ Next meeting confirmed via email

Note:Ensure fields:Solution Area of Interest,Application Segment,Application Market.Application and Disease Condition are filled out

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Stage 2: Qualify


KEY ACTIVITIES

  • Confirm or get pain admitted & explore vision customer has to resolve
  • Create or reengineer vision
  • Position unique capabilities
  • Ask for access to power & agree upon next steps
  • Identify buying committee

Exit Criteria

✓Sponsor Confirmation email agreed upon

Note:Ensure fields:FAS Input Required,Funding and Territory fields are filled out

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Stage 3: Develop


KEY ACTIVITIES

  • Confirm or get pain admitted w/Power & explore vision customer has to resolve
  • Create or reengineer vision
  • Position differentiated capabilities
  • Determine evaluation criteria, propose Evaluation Plan & agree upon next steps

Exit Criteria

✓Power Sponsor Confirmation email & Evaluation Plan agreed upon

Note:Use the "Edit stage 3 button" to access and complete all mandatory fields required at this stage.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Stage 4: Prove


Key Activities

  • Begin execution of next steps plan
  • Prove differentiated capabilities
  • Receive verbal approval 
  • Discuss Integration Plan & Success Criteria

Exit Criteria

﻿✓Verbal approval received

Note:Ensure fields:Close Date fields is filled out

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Stage 5: Negotiation


KEY ACTIVITIES

  • Prepare for final negotiations
  • Develop get/give list
  • Reach final agreement
  • Get necessary documents signed
  • Confirm Kick off date

Exit Criteria

✓Signed documents


Note: Ensure these fields are filled out.

  1. Close Date,
  2. SOW Complete,
  3. MSA Complete,
  4. Pricing approved internally
  5. Revenue Rec Date
  6. SOW Complete,
  7. MSA Complete,
  8. Pricing approved internally fields are mandatory for Service Sales.

Stage: Closed Won


Successfully won the Opportunity!


Required Fields: Closed Reason,Closed Reason Detail , Whether this is Demo or Samples run, and the SAP Order #
